[P2] Apply the process-exit guard to the shared runner

`_run_collection` bounds event-loop teardown, but a blocked `to_thread` worker can remain alive afterward. An SDK script exiting with `runner.run(...)` then waits indefinitely during interpreter shutdown, preventing the run stage from finishing despite its budgets. The existing `app.run` guard handles this separately, but this entry point bypasses it. Share that guarded process-exit path with the runner and add a subprocess regression with a blocked worker; the new async-task test does not cover this case.
